services.name: Private Events at NAAM
services.desc: NAAM offers over 4,200 sq. ft. of high-quality, private event space for all occasions. Our facilities feature large vintage windows, high ceilings, hardwood floors, artist studios, outdoor patios and free parking. Let our courteous staff assist you with all the finishing touches to help personalize your event. NAAM is a proud member of AAAM and GSBA. NAAM was a national finalist for the National Medal for Museum & Library Service Award and received the 2019 & 2023 AKCHO award for Excellence in Public
